svg.title: The original pipeline benchmark
svg.desc: August 7 exploratory comparison, four tasks and one trial per configuration. Codex vanilla passed four tasks at 3.6 minutes mean; the pipeline passed three at 18.5 minutes, 5.1 times as long. Claude vanilla passed four at 6.9 minutes; the pipeline passed two at 23.4 minutes, 3.4 times as long.
